data.body: AC amendment (gap G4): Add explicit cross-binding check as a T1 sub-deliverable. check_dual_identity_complete builds an `active_bindings` index at entry: {local_id: jira_key} for every Jira issue whose dso_local_id property is set. For any Mode B candidate (label present, property missing), if the implied local_id appears in active_bindings under a DIFFERENT jira_key, skip seed_repair_property AND quarantine the candidate instead. RED test fixture REQUIRED: local-A bound to DIG-1 via property + DIG-2 has dso-id-localA label without property → expect quarantine on DIG-2 (NOT a repair_property mutation that would create at-most-one conflict).
